case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

messages.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your alternative proposals; we are always open to finding a workable solution for both sides.

Our current offer stands at a price of €51.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

We are willing to extend the contract to 24 months and accommodate 45-day payment terms, but the price must remain realistic. We can offer €51.40 for this package, which is a significant concession on our part. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €51.40 per unit. As an alternative package, we can present a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your revised proposal; it is good to see your willingness to move. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This proposal remains valid for 30 days. 

In response, we have reviewed our calculations and can offer a further concession to €51.20 for the 45-day payment term. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

We value our long-standing relationship and hope this brings us closer to a workable solution.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised proposal; we appreciate your continued willingness to find a solution. Our family foundry has valued our shared history and long relationship with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years, and we take great pride in the quality of the work our people deliver to you.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our primary Angebot stands at a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. In response to your movement, we can offer a further concession to €51.10 for the 45-day payment term, alongside a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.

We have moved significantly from our initial offer, and we look forward to a more substantial step from your side to reach an agreement. Please note that this proposal remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

I appreciate the significant step you have taken in your pricing, which reflects the value of our long-standing partnership. However, your proposal delays the effective date to 2027-04-01, meaning we must carry the current conditions for several more months. 

To accommodate this later start date, I can offer a price of €51.50 for the 60-day payment term. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our current Angebot consists of a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 7 days. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Thank you for your order. Our order confirmation is attached. 

For generations, our family foundry has taken deep pride in delivering quality casting to our valued partners in the region. We truly appreciate the long relationship between our companies, and our skilled craftsmen are already preparing to execute your order with the utmost care and dedication.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
